top_choice_rationale: P001 names Kane, Mele and Molenkamp for a single coherent chain: the Z2 classification and quantum spin Hall proposal for time-reversal-invariant insulators, followed by the first observation of protected edge conductance in HgTe wells. It is mature after fifteen to twenty years of independent transport, ARPES and first-principles confirmation, and the three-person allocation follows the theory-to-experiment chain while the citation can be worded narrowly. P002 (Katori and Ye) is a sound, compact invention with measured consequences, but it sits closer to the earlier frequency-comb prize and the redefinition of the second has not happened, so it ranks second. No award is ranked last because two mature, well-attributed achievements are available.
